item.title: Codex
item.description: This page explains how to connect Codex to an already running ShardingSphere-MCP HTTP Server. Prerequisites Start the HTTP MCP Server by following Quick Start. Codex CLI or the Codex IDE extension is available. The Codex environment can reach http://127.0.0.1:18088/mcp, or the actual MCP Server address you configured. Add the MCP Server Use Codex CLI to add ShardingSphere-MCP: codex mcp add shardingsphere --url http://127.0.0.1:18088/mcp Verify that it has been added:
